| Version | Name | In repo at pinned `6bde0f4`? | Where the file is |

| 20261019100000 | secdef_rpc_tenant_guards | no | `origin/main` (`87e5e40`) via PR #146 (`6c75d9b`), commit `6c0d157`: `packages/supabase/migrations/20261019100000_secdef_rpc_tenant_guards.sql` (291 lines) |

Both are intended hardening changes that reached `main` after the pinned commit; the pinned snapshot is behind `main` (see CONTEXT L-38). The version names match the repo files, so on `origin/main` these two are **not** drift. They are counted as live-only below only because the comparison is against `6bde0f4`. Their catalog effects are listed in `database.md` → "Live drift since the first snapshot".

`origin/main` also carries PR #145 ("mirror production's full migration history into the repo", `7112acc`), which adds a `packages/supabase/live-history/` directory (README plus per-version files; 342 files changed in that commit) instead of new files under `migrations/`; `packages/supabase/migrations/` holds 284 entries on `origin/main` vs 282 at `6bde0f4` (the +2 are the files above). The two lists below were computed at `6bde0f4` and are **not** recomputed against `origin/main` (Phase 1 re-pin decision).

`20261012120000_search_orders_v2.sql` and `20261014120000_v_orders_with_risk_contact_columns.sql` remain repo-only and **not applied live** (re-checked 00:41 UTC: no `search_orders_v2` in `pg_proc`); the app calls `search_orders_v2` at `apps/platform/lib/repositories/order-repository.ts:448` with a fallback at `:453`.
